name: 天富命
notes: child of 大宮賣命; father of 飯長姫命

name: 由布津主命 (阿八和氣比古命)
notes: Ame no Hiwashi's grandson; married 飯長姫命, dau. of Ame no Tomi; produced 堅田主命 = 'first ancestor of the Awa Inbe'

name: 訶多多主命
notes: Awa writes 訶多々主命; Okajima also gives 堅田主命

name: 見都万侶
notes: Awa has 止保志 between 多氣毘古 and 見都万侶

name: 由岐万侶
notes: Awa has 岐久和氣 between

name: 大左和氣
notes: Awa has 伊久毘古 and 多岐雄 between

name: 名美麻呂
notes: Awa has 理岐万呂 between; Awa dates 名美麻呂's death to Hakuhō 11 (late 7th c.) — a century off

name: 久米麻呂
notes: Awa: d. Yōrō 4 (720) — over a century off
